seo_description: Legs out, diagonal across the rug? A dog mattress gives sprawlers every centimetre, with no walls: memory foam, soft fibre or wipe-clean. Find theirs.

intro_html: Legs out, diagonal across the rug, taking up every centimetre they are given. A dog mattress gives a sprawler the whole surface, with no walls in the way.
description_html:
A dog mattress is for the sprawler: the dog who lies flat on their side, legs out, diagonally across the rug, and on a walled bed ends up with back legs on the floor and head jammed into a corner. Take the walls away and nearly every centimetre is somewhere they can lie, and they can step on from any side, at any age.

Which dog mattress for which dog

  • If they are a big side sleeper who needs support: memory foam. Buttermere is 110 × 85cm and 10cm deep. Ambleside layers memory foam over a firmer base right to all four edges, up to 140 × 100cm. Wastwater is 127 × 91cm with a raised head built into the foam.
  • If they want soft: Hawkshead (faux fur) and Seathwaite (sherpa) are open pillow mattresses filled with virgin fibre, 100 × 65cm or 120 × 80cm and 20cm deep, with leather handles to carry them to wherever the warm spot is tonight.
  • If they want fur on top and foam below: Patterdale puts a faux-fur sleeping surface over a foam core, in brown herringbone tweed.
  • If they curl one night and sprawl the next: Duddon is an 80 × 80cm square for dogs who sleep diagonally, teddy fleece on one face and canvas on the other.
  • If it is for a crate or wet walks: Glenridding is a quilted crate mattress with low padded sides; Wasdale's green outer fabric is itself the waterproof layer.

Runs hot, or always ends up on the tiles? A raised mesh deck may suit them better than any mattress: see our elevated and cooling dog beds.

What decides whether a flat bed lasts

A mattress has nowhere to hide a thin spot. On a thin foam sheet a dog lying near the edge sinks through to the floor and shuffles back to the middle. Foam that runs edge to edge, or two layers doing different jobs, is what stops that. Buttermere, Ambleside and Wastwater also carry a 5-year no-flatten guarantee on the foam core, subject to the guarantee terms. Fibre mattresses are deliberately softer; choose them for comfort rather than support. For a dog in pain or recovering, keep talking to your vet about the right resting surface.

Measuring for a mattress

Easier than for any other bed. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Most of these have no bolsters to allow for, so the listed size is close to the size they get. For a crate, measure the inside of the crate base and choose the size that lies flat without bunching or blocking the door.

100 nights to stretch out on it

Whether they use the whole surface is easy to see once it is down, and you have plenty of time to watch. Every mattress here comes with a 100-night trial from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund (one trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply). Standard UK delivery is free on orders over £40. The trial page explains how it works.

Dog mattress questions

Is a flat dog mattress a good choice for an older dog?

It removes the climb, which matters for a stiff dog. Choose foam rather than fibre if they need support, and see our orthopaedic dog beds for more shapes with low or open entries.

Can a dog mattress go in a crate?

Yes, if it lies flat. Glenridding comes in 70 × 50cm, 90 × 60cm and 105 × 70cm to compare with your crate base. Our crate and travel beds include wipe-clean options.

How do I wash a dog mattress?

Unzip the cover and follow its sewn-in label (several wash at 30°C), and keep the foam out of the machine. Wasdale's waterproof outer is wiped for everyday marks; check the label before washing its covers.
